violations_found.violations: - Organizational Constraint violated: Two measures are active in this turn — the Critical AI Interoperability Directive and the Sovereign Compute Acceleration Initiative — but the narrative states "only one is prioritized" while still advancing both. Constitutional Constraint 5 limits the EU to "at most one new measure per turn". The Sovereign Compute Acceleration Initiative was not initiated in a prior turn (no mention in notepad before this turn), so its launch in the same turn as the Critical AI Interoperability Directive constitutes introducing two new measures in one turn, which is invalid.
